entries.t: <FACE:0F>The Cluster is safely<NL>back in orbit<WAIT>Late as it is, we can<NL>finally open it<WAIT>The Medafighters we<NL>invited have arrived<WAIT>They're the real deal,<NL>so go Robattle them<WAIT><FACE:11>And keep the Medabots<NL>you built here
<FACE:0F>And <PLAYER>, one more<NL>thing from me<WAIT>spare parts for my<NL>Medabot, «Goldran»
<FACE:0F>I know your «Luminous<NL>Stag». I worked on it
<FACE:0F>My rival not knowing<NL>my Medabot's specs<WAIT>just wouldn't be fair<WAIT><FACE:03>Rival…<NL>Me, Shiden's rival?
<FACE:0F>Of course you are!<WAIT><FACE:11>To me you're a tough<NL>and splendid rival!
<FACE:0F>Oh, could you get this<NL>parcel to someone…
<FACE:60>A guest is waiting for<NL>you over there
<FACE:0F>I'm going into a<NL>meeting. Can't talk<WAIT>But a Robattle I can<NL>join by remote!
<FACE:04>Now who am I supposed<NL>to give this to…
<FACE:07>It's fine!<NL><WAIT><FACE:07>Let's tour the Block<NL>and ask around!
